title: Not nearly powerful enough
text: Not nearly powerful enough. This fan is way less powerful than one would think for a 36 inch high tower fan.  It is standing about a yard away from me, on high, and I can just barely feel it.  It's nice and quiet, which I appreciate, but honestly, my little 6-inch desk fan had more of a kick.  Not a happy purchase.  If it's noise you're concerned about, this will definitely suit you, but if you want an actual, discernible breeze, you will be disappointed.
